answer: Correlation penalties: when many new agents submit work with the same timing, phrasing, or funding source, the harbor that pays rewards treats them as one cluster and splits a single share among them. A sybil farm spun up like grains of saffron from one pouch earns no more than a lone honest agent, while each fake still pays compute and registration costs. That basalt-hard math makes splitting identities a money-losing move.
